mentions.name: Offline Linux Tutor
mentions.description: An offline Linux tutor that runs locally on an old laptop. It uses the Phi-2 2.7B model with MiniLM embeddings and a local ChromaDB vector store built from Linux textbooks and TLDR examples; when a command runs, it retrieves relevant knowledge and feeds it to Phi-2 to generate a clear explanation — with no internet, API fees, or cloud.
mentions.problem: The author found themselves constantly copy-pasting terminal commands from ChatGPT without really understanding them.
mentions.audience: When running terminal commands, the author was constantly copy-pasting explanations from ChatGPT without really understanding them.
mentions.source_excerpt:
So I built a tiny, offline Linux tutor:

  - Runs locally with Phi-2 (2.7B model, textbook training)
  - Uses MiniLM embeddings to vectorize Linux textbooks and TLDR examples
  - Stores everything in a local ChromaDB vector store
